fll.title: FIRST LEGO League
fll.description: FIRST® LEGO® League introduces STEM to children ages 4-14 through fun, exciting hands-on learning. Participants gain real-world problem-solving experiences through a guided, global robotics program, helping today’s students and teachers build a better future together. The three divisions inspire youth to experiment and grow their critical thinking, coding, and design skills through hands-on STEM learning and robotics.

ftc.title: FIRST Tech Challenge
ftc.description: FIRST® Tech Challenge students learn to think like engineers. Teams design, build, and program robots to compete in an alliance format against other teams. Robots are built from a reusable platform, powered by android technology, and can be coded using a variety of levels of Java-based programming.

frc.title: FIRST Robotics Competition
frc.description: FIRST® Robotics Competition teams design, program, and build a robot starting with a standard kit of parts and common set of rules to play in a themed head-to-head challenge. Teams also build a brand, develop community partnerships for support, and work to promote STEM in their local community.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: Purpose Mechack exists to create a new generation of innovators and problem-solvers. We inspire young minds to explore science, technology, engineering, and math while building teamwork and leadership skills.

collaboration.title: Vision
collaboration.text: To bring scientific and technological innovations to the culture of our country, to form new habits and new perspectives. To create a society where science and technology thrive.

innovation.title: Mission
innovation.text: The mission of Mechacak is to provide and disseminate transformative robotics programs that build skills, confidence, and resilience in young people to build a better world, modeled after the mission of FIRST.

About.storyP1: We Are Building the Future! We are Azerbaijan's first FIRST team! Three years ago, we embarked on a great mission—to create enlightenment in the fields of science, technology, and engineering! This was not just about forming a team; we paved a new path for the youth of our country! We have trained more than 100 FIRST members! We didn't just share knowledge; we changed mindsets! We introduced young people to the power of science and technology, teaching them how to create, build, and innovate. Now, young minds from different regions of Azerbaijan are shaping the future with their ideas. We are not just a team—we are the pioneers of FRC! We are spreading this vision and inspiring more young people to join this movement! But this is just the beginning! We want to expand this growth to every corner of the country! More young people should be introduced to science and engineering, and with your support, we can turn Azerbaijan into an FRC regional hub! We planted the seed—now it's time to grow it together!
